title: The CIA triad: confidentiality, integrity and availability

videos.script: A small bookshop sells online. Think about what could go wrong for it. {{shop}} A stranger could read the customer list. Somebody could change a price from forty-five reais to four. Or the shop could simply stop answering. {{three}} Those are three different harms, and security has a name for what each one damages. Confidentiality, integrity and availability. {{triad}} In this lesson you will see the second and third happen in the course's lab. A price file changes by one character, and a checksum catches it. The shop's server stops, and the page stops loading. {{lab}} Then you will see where the three pull against each other. Every control you meet in this course protects at least one of them, and sometimes costs another. {{tradeoff}}
